nodes.name: DB: Step 1 — add ledger columns to recurring_payment_schedule

parameters.query:
ALTER TABLE bookings.recurring_payment_schedule
  ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS total_cycles     INT,
  ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS remaining_cycles INT,
  ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS billing_day      INT CHECK (billing_day BETWEEN 1 AND 31),
  ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS upfront_paid     BOOLEAN NOT NULL DEFAULT false;

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS bookings.outstanding_payments (
  id                UUID          PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),
  tenant_id         INT           NOT NULL,
  recurring_rule_id UUID          REFERENCES bookings.recurring_rules(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
  customer_id       UUID          REFERENCES bookings.customers(id),
  period_start      DATE          NOT NULL,
  amount_due        NUMERIC(10,2) NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
  due_date          DATE          NOT NULL,
  status            TEXT          NOT NULL DEFAULT 'pending' CHECK (status IN ('pending','paid','cancelled')),
  email_sent_at     TIMESTAMPTZ,
  paid_at           TIMESTAMPTZ,
  created_at        TIMESTAMPTZ   NOT NULL DEFAULT NOW(),
  UNIQUE (recurring_rule_id, period_start)
);

  ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS billing_day    INT CHECK (billing_day BETWEEN 1 AND 31),
  ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS total_months   INT,
  ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS upfront_paid   BOOLEAN NOT NULL DEFAULT false;
